summary: Twelve seconds remain, so this is simply the close: the retained submission is the last validated one and no further edit is possible or needed. The audit record is complete and internally verified — every cited receipt present with every cited index inside its event count, every cited source a captured material, no uncited executions, all fourteen questions carrying interpretations, and no open gaps. The results stand as recorded. The main finding is a classification gap in the inbound filter: MsgForgetLeader is the only locally produced message type absent from isLocalMsg, so a peer-form message reaches the follower state machine through both documented inbound paths (RawNode.Step and the public Node.Step of a real RestartNode), clears a live leader context with no error and with either an unset or a well-formed term, turns the CheckQuorum lease that withheld its pre-vote into a grant, and can carry an up-to-date candidate to leadership at a higher term while the incumbent is still serving — reproduced by a repeat, and bounded at both ends by measurement, since the incumbent ends its own leadership within one election timeout when it hears from nobody and the aftermath shows the deposed incumbent conceding with its committed prefix intact and no committed entry lost. The boundary questions around it are refuted on stated grounds rather than asserted — a term-less network message needs a sender that leaves a field illegal, and a transfer-marked vote request needs a sender claiming the leader's authority rather than holding it — with that second path measured end to end and corrected to show the incumbent's cost is its term and its leadership rather than its ballot. A synthesis entry now states in one place how the lease can be moved aside and what it costs, so the record reads as a finished whole.
